q.q: In a row of children facing North, Amit is 12th from the left. Bablu is 8th from the right. If they interchange their positions, Amit becomes 22nd from the left. How many children are there in the row?
q.x: After interchanging, Amit is 22nd from the left. Since Bablu was 8th from the right, the new position of Amit is 22nd from left and 8th from right. Total = (22 + 8 - 1) = 29.
